Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. I checked transfer TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to your Access Bank account 0234567891) directly with the bank, and their final status confirms it was actually successful — it shows as "Credited to the recipient account" on 21 November 2026 at 14:02.

So we won't be resending the payment, as that would result in a double payment. Here are the details to give your bank if you can't see the credit in your statement:

- Amount: ₦250,000
- Bank: Access Bank
- Account: 0234567891
- Value/reference date: 21 November 2026, 14:02
- Session ID: 000014261121140211000088

Please check your account statement (including any pending/unposted credits) and confirm with your bank branch using the session ID above. If after that the money still can't be located on your side, let us know and we'll take it up further.

Best regards,
Operations Assistant, Mama's Kitchen
